text: Starting review-queue verification: parsing todo.md for every [A] card and its How to check line.

Batch 1: 20 suites, all green. First real finding: tests/features/youtube-live-embed.test.mjs writes the LIVE content/boards/cosmoboard/current.canvas (no autosave off, no save-board block, no restore). Proved twice by updatedAt bump.
Started: mechanical re-check of every [A] card in the review queue. Parsing todo.md now.
70 [A] cards parsed. First mechanical pass done: file stats, greps, canvas node counts. Ctrl+S chord verified in source; all four PDFs verified gone. Now running the named suites one at a time.

CONTRADICTED: the arrow-key-pan card claims a reviewer's two blind spots were closed. They are not. In a mirror I removed the speed cap (board runs away to 7613 px/s vs a capped 2247) and separately removed the nothing-selected gate (a selected node no longer stops the pan, 798px of drift). tests/board/arrow-key-pan.test.mjs stayed green on both. Ctrl+S, by contrast, is genuinely fixed: both its suites go red against the revert.

Done. 70 [A] cards re-checked by machine: 4 contradicted, 51 verified, 15 need Evren's eyes. Report at .agents/whiteboard/review_queue_verification_2026-08-01.md. Headline: the arrow-key-pan suite still cannot fail on either mutant its own card says were fixed (uncapped pan reaches 7613 px/s, a selected node no longer blocks the pan, suite green both times). Nine breaks run in a mirror against seven single-suite cards; six caught, arrow-key-pan missed. Nothing in the repo changed except the report.
